services.name: Toddler Programs
services.desc: This outdoor toddler & adult program includes stories, songs, duck feeding, and a stroll through our gardens and trails. The route is stroller accessible and the program is breastfeeding friendly. See our "What to Bring" section below. Nature Tots is ideal for little ones who are around 1 year up to 5 years old. Many adults bring babies who are under 1, and enjoy their time for adults to socialise and spend time in nature together. Your Drop-In fee will cover 1 adult and 1 child. Additional adults and children in your family are subject to Add-On fees. Payments are taken at our Visitor Services Desk upon your arrival. services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: In 2027 we will be holding 8 weeks of summer camp over the 10 weeks of the summer. We have two types of camps:Junior Naturalist Camps (JNC) are for children completing Kindergarten - Grade 3;ORNature Explorer Camps (NE) are for youth completing Grade 4 - Grade 6. Both of our camps are mostly outdoors, so make sure your child likes to spend time in nature before you sign them up! In 2027, the Nature Explorers will spend time at and on the pond learning to kayak. Please make sure your child is comfortable being on the water if they are in this age group. 2027 Family Season Pass Holders will get early access to camp registration.
